data.name: Empowered Path
data.description: You add +%1 to your manifester level when manifesting a path power.  If you expend your psionic focus when manifesting a power, the power is automatically augmented for the manifester level boost (minimum 1), but you pay no extra power points for this boost.|EmpoweredPathMLBonus
